podcast.body: Released in the summer of 1997, "Tubthumping" became an unexpectedly massive hit, rapidly climbing the charts on both sides of the Atlantic despite the band's unconventional history and strong political ideology. "Meanwhile, a long comes in a single called tub thumping that flew up the charts on both sides of the Atlantic, massive hit."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
